title: Growth
description: A two-player board game: dice rolls and chosen strategies grow X and O until the board holds 64 pieces.
versionOrder: Disk saves have no recorded order or dates beyond their source comments. Any ordering here is a presentation guess.

versions.label: Growth (blocks 34-40)
versions.note: Source blocks copied unchanged from the New Programs disk. The player boots the Forth System disk and loads them with the original commands. Checked to its first screen only.

attribution.text: From a 1982 MMSFORTH disk; the source names no author. Runs on MMSFORTH V2.0, © 1981 Miller Microcomputer Services. Preserved here for small-scale archival use.

howTo: At WHICH STRATEGY each player picks a number from the choices shown, then press Enter to keep the current value. Higher numbers grow faster but carry their own risks. The pieces then grow by themselves; press the keys the game shows to change strategy.
quickHelp: Pick a strategy number when asked; the board then grows by itself.
